process.process_description: This page concerns the Masterarbeit for Human‑ and Zahnmedizin Master students: the thesis is mandatory in the Master programme and a prerequisite for admission to the federal examination. To find a supervisor or topic students are directed to the Virtuelle Ausbildungsplattform Medizin (VAM > Masterarbeit), which hosts a "Handbuch", an online Themenbörse to match supervisors and students, a mini‑guide for supervisors and assorted documents. Formal registration steps and deadlines are not specified on this page. Plagiarism rules are explicit: the Faculty policy (22 May 2019) requires supervisors/mentors to check theses (students must consent), and the absence of suspicion must be confirmed at submission; suspected cases are referred to the Masterarbeitskommission. Official guidelines are on VAM and the faculty's plagiarism‑policy PDF; contact: Sandra Lang, Studiendekanat.
